best_idea: Measure bag capacity in fractional slot sizes, let each wield slot push its displaced item into the pack, and make every move one validated, all-or-nothing change.
decision_why: Keep the size-capacity bag and the wield-eviction table for Frankendom gear and loot, but validate before any change and fix the displaced-item loss the donor has, so the one ledger never drops an item.
acceptance: A full-pack player who wields a second sword sees the first sword in the pack or gets pack full with no change; a server test asserts total slot size is equal before and after every move and that a refused move leaves the ledger unchanged.
